translations.en: The report is not like witnessing.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: War is deception.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: A Muslim is a mirror of the Muslim.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Someone whose advice is sought is in a position of trust.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The person guiding (someone) to do a good deed, is like the one performing the good deed.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Seek help for any needs discreetly.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Protect yourself from the fire even with a part of a date.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: الدُّنْیَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤمِنِ وَ جَنَّةُ الْکَافِرِ

translations.en: The world is the believer’s prison and the disbeliever’s paradise.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Modesty is entirely good.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The word of the believer is like seizing of the hand.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: لَا یَحِلُّ لِمُؤمِنٍ اَنْ یَّجُهْرَ أخَاهُ فَوقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أیَّامٍ

translations.en: It is unlawful for a believer to sever relations with his brother for more than three days.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: He is not one of us who cheats us.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: مَا قَلَّ وَكَفَى خَيْرٌ مِمَّا كَثُرَ وَأَلْهَى

translations.en: A little that suffices is better than an abundance that distracts.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: الرَّاجِعُ فِيْ هِبَتِهِ کَالرَّاجِعِ فِيْ قَیْئِهِ

translations.en: Someone who takes back his gift is like someone who eats his vomit.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Affliction comes from (loose) talk.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: People are like the teeth of a comb.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Richness lies in the richness of the soul.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The felicitous person takes lessons from (the actions of) others.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: وَ إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ لَحِکْمَةً وَاِنَّ مِنَ الْبَیَانِ لَسِحْرًا

translations.en: Indeed, in poetry there is wisdom and in eloquence there is magic.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The king’s pardon preserves the kingdom.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: A man will be with whom he loves.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: A man who knows his worth will not be ruined.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The child belongs to the bed and stoning is for the adulterer.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: الْیَدُ الْعُلْیَا خَیْرٌ مِّنَ الْیَدِ السُّفْلَی

translations.en: The upper hand is superior to the lower hand.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: لَا شَکَرَ اللهَ مَنْ لَّا یَشْکُرُ النَّاسَ

translations.en: He does not thank Allah who does not thank people.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Your love of something can blind and deafen (you).

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: جُبِلَتِ الْقُلُوبُ عَلی حُبَّ مَنْ اَحْسَنَ اِلَیْهَا وَ بُغْضِ مَنْ اَسَاءَ اِلَیْهَا

translations.en: Hearts are predisposed to love someone who does them good and detest someone who does them harm.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: الْتَّائِبُ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ کَمَنْ لَا ذَنْبَ لَهُ

translations.en: One who repents from sin is like someone without sin.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: الشَّاهِدُ یَرَی مَا لَا یَرَاهُ الْغَائِبُ

translations.en: The person who actually witnesses an (event) sees that which one who is absent does not.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: If the nobleman of a people comes to you, honour him.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: False oaths lay waste to home (lands).

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِیْدٌ

translations.en: Whoever is killed attempting to save his property is a martyr.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Actions are through intentions.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The leader of a people is their servant.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The best of affairs is that which is balanced.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِیْ أُمَّتِیْ فِی بُکُوْرِهَا یَوْمَ الْخَمِیْسِ

translations.en: O Allah, bless my nation in its early rising on Thursdays!

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Poverty can almost turn into disbelief.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Travelling is a portion of punishment.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: The best of provision is God-Consciousness (taqwa).

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40

translations.en: Meetings are under trust.

sourceLabel: The Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah · eng-shahwaliullah40
